messages:
sara: Heads up — our CI preview jobs started getting 403s calling the private model endpoint after the SA permission changes this morning. Token shows up in logs as valid but API returns: \"403 Forbidden: caller does not have permission\". Using GH Actions -> workload identity -> impersonate ci-preview@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com

sara: Example curl we run (from runner):
```
curl -sS -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \"https://api.redwood-inference.internal/v1/generate\" 
```

ben: can you paste the decoded token payload (just the claims)? check aud/exp/iss. also was there a PR that tightened the IAM condition? @infra-team

sara: pasted decoded claims (trimmed):
```
{
  \"iss\": \"https://sts.googleapis.com/\",
  \"sub\": \"serviceAccount:ci-preview@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com\",
  \"aud\": \"https://accounts.google.com\",
  \"exp\": 3172501200
}
```

sara: note aud is \"https://accounts.google.com\" — looks suspicious. this token used to work before the condition change in PR #1421. :thinking_face:

eli: that aud indicates it's an identity token (id_token) not an OAuth access token. Our model endpoint needs an access token with proper scopes (or an impersonated access token). GH/OIDC flow often returns id_tokens by default. did the runner exchange the id_token for an access token before calling the API?

ben: +1. quick repro: from the runner try both: 
`gcloud auth print-identity-token --impersonate-service-account=ci-preview@...` (id token) vs 
`gcloud auth print-access-token --impersonate-service-account=ci-preview@...` (access token). API will accept the access token.

eli: if the runner only set `ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL` -> that gives you an OIDC id_token. Before we tightened IAM conditions, the endpoint accepted id_tokens issued to the SA. After tightening (we added a condition requiring `token.aud == \"redwood-internal\"`), the id_token no longer matched. Two options:
- change the GH OIDC mapping / audience so the id_token aud matches new condition (harder), or
- keep GH as-is but have the runner use the id_token to call STS to exchange for an access token scoped for the API (recommended).

infra-team: quick mitigation: we granted `iam.serviceAccounts.getAccessToken` (iamCredentials.generateAccessToken) to the runner-impersonator service account temporarily. that lets the CI exchange for an access token with the right scopes. long-term we'll add a small helper step in the runner image to call `gcloud iam service-accounts generate-access-token --impersonate-service-account=ci-preview@... --scope=https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform` and use that token to call the API.

sara: confirming: after adding iamCredentials permission to the impersonator the preview job passed and model call succeeded. :white_check_mark: will revert permissive grant and instead add the explicit exchange step in the workflow. creating follow-up ticket to update GH runner image and document the flow.

ben: for debugging in future, you can introspect tokens: id_token -> `https://oauth2.googleapis.com/tokeninfo?id_token=$IDTOKEN`; access_token -> `https://www.googleapis.com/oauth2/v3/tokeninfo?access_token=$ACCTOKEN`. the tokeninfo output makes mis-aud issues obvious.

sara: thanks all — filing an ops task and PR for runner fix. cc @eli for the workflow snippet.

deploy-bot: preview deployment CI succeeded for commit abc123 after token exchange workaround.
